page.mainTitle: Custom solutions for operating your installations

intro.p1: Our control command cabinets are designed and custom-built to meet the specific requirements of each hydroelectric project. Each cabinet is the result of dedicated engineering integrating the latest automation technologies.
intro.p2: We ensure complete design from electrical studies to manufacturing in our workshops, including PLC programming and graphical interfaces as well as factory validation before delivery.

features.title: Main Features
items: Management of normal or fast shutdown sequences and emergency in case of faults
Automatic starts and stops based on water levels and/or energy spot prices
Opening, power, and head limitations for low-head plants
Maintenance mode allowing individual control of components and motors for safe testing
Water intake safety and security control

newProjects.title: New Projects
newProjects.p1: The control command system and more generally all electrical equipment are often underconsidered when carrying out a project. Production equipment (turbines and generators) captures all attention for various reasons (higher costs, efficiency, etc.).
newProjects.p2: These systems are however an essential factor in the reliability and productivity of an installation and have a direct impact on project profitability.
newProjects.p3: Optimal integration of the control command system with production equipment ensures ease of daily operation of the installation as well as simplified maintenance, thus contributing to reducing operating costs.

page.subtitle: Intelligent and Secure Supervision
intro: Our SCADA systems (Supervisory Control And Data Acquisition) offer comprehensive and intuitive supervision of your hydroelectric installations to operate both production units and water intakes and dams. Developed with particular attention to ergonomics, they allow optimal operation of your installations.
Each SCADA is custom developed with a modern graphical interface and real-time animated synoptics. The refined aesthetics facilitate adoption and reduce operators' cognitive load.
Our SCADA systems integrate advanced functions: alarm management, data logging, preventive maintenance support tools, remote access, etc.

Our systems development relies on market software solutions (standard software, proven solutions) and a multi-vendor approach. This choice guarantees an open and independent architecture, essential for platform sustainability.
We create hypervision systems that unify and secure all your sites. Connected via VPN, they are controlled from a single interface.

page.subtitle: Regulators for Kaplan, Francis and Pelton turbines

intro.title: Speed control
intro.p1: Our automatic regulation systems ensure automated unit operation, designed to adapt to all types of turbines: Kaplan, Francis and Pelton. These solutions are designed to optimize performance and guarantee stable operation, both in island mode and connected to the grid. All PLCs use a PID regulation algorithm, compliant with IEC 61362 and IEEE 125 standards.
intro.p2: Based on PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) technology, our regulator guarantees high responsiveness in managing load and grid fluctuations, while offering the robustness necessary for continuous operation in demanding industrial environments.

intro.title: Complete Integration of Electrical Systems
intro.p1: We provide engineering and integration of all electrical equipment necessary for the operation of a hydroelectric power plant, from high voltage substations to auxiliary distributions. We perform short-circuit and protection selectivity studies using dedicated software.
intro.p2: HV/EHV substations include step-up transformers, switchgear and circuit breakers, and all equipment necessary for evacuating the produced energy to the grid.
intro.p3: Auxiliaries – or electrical Balance of Plant (eBoP) – include all auxiliary electrical equipment essential to ensure proper plant operation.

page.subtitle: Industry 4.0 - IoT - BigData
intro: Our Data Visualization solutions transform your raw data into actionable information. Through the integration of IoT and BigData technologies, we collect, store and analyze all data from your installations, whether production data (power, levels, temperatures, speed, unit operating status, etc.) or alarms. It is also possible to enrich this database with information from Vigicrue or Météo France or other sources.

Dynamic dashboards provide a real-time view of your essential KPIs: production, availability, capacity factor, and much more. Each dashboard is customizable according to your needs and includes features such as the logbook for recording events. This facilitates data analysis, trend identification, detection of unusual drift and thus contributes to optimizing the efficiency of your installations.
Access to this platform is via a web server, ensuring compatibility with any type of device (PC, smartphone) and benefiting from a password-secured authentication system.
